rationale.conceptual: The method is the paper's own custom design, not an off-the-shelf architecture. It requires understanding of generalized solvation free energy, local maximum likelihood approximation, neural network force field implementation, coordinate conversion via NeRF algorithm, and a differentiable optimization loss with smooth L1 regularization. Several interacting components and non-trivial math must be correctly translated into code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline comprises four main stages (feature extraction, neural network training, benchmark preparation, refinement evaluation) with dependencies between them. Data assembly from external sources (PDB, 3Drobot) and the need to loop over 10800 decoys with both model variants add complexity, though no extreme tooling or fragile handoffs. This fits a multi-stage orchestration with moderate engineering.
